description: Impact Analysis — return the BLAST RADIUS for a file or symbol. Lists every file (and, where helpful, function) that could break if you change the target. Polymorphic on target: a path-like string ('src/foo.ts') triggers file-mode; a name-like string ('validateUser') triggers symbol-mode. Use this BEFORE refactoring, renaming, or deleting code to know what depends on it.

depth.description: How many hops back to walk (default 3, max 10).

file.description: Optional file path to disambiguate the target symbol.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

target.description: Target file path (relative) OR symbol name.

name: codebase_impact
